content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Fellow: Master's degree (MBA/M.Sc./MTech/MA or equivalent) in Agriculture and allied/Agribusiness Management/Food Business Management/Food Technology/Supply Chain Management/Agricultural Economics/Environmental Science/Sustainability Management/Rural Management or an allied discipline from a recognized university/institution, with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent CGPA.

content_sections.text: Project Fellow: Rs. 25,000/- per month (consolidated; no other allowances admissible).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIFTEM Project Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIFTEM to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management (NIFTEM) for research positions based in Sonipat, Haryana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised position is Project Fellow under the project titled INTEGRATED SUSTAINABLE VALUE CHAIN & CARBON REVENUE GENERATION MODEL FOR AGRO-FOOD COMPANIES AND FPOS IN HARYANA.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Fellow position under advertisement number N/E/FBM/2026/0175.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for NIFTEM Project Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the NIFTEM Project Fellow recruitment is 20-10-2026. Candidates must complete submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Agriculture and allied, Agribusiness Management, Food Business Management, Food Technology, Supply Chain Management, Agricultural Economics, Environmental Science, Sustainability Management, Rural Management, or equivalent with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants applying for this role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxation for reserved category candidates is applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What salary will be offered to the selected Project Fellow?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month with no other allowances admissible.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for NIFTEM Project Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Interested candidates need to submit their forms through the official portal designated for career applications.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this project position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing of candidates based on qualifications followed by a personal or technical interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find queries or official assistance regarding this recruitment?
faq.answer: For any queries or assistance regarding the application process, candidates can write an official email to the designated contact at [email protected].
